name: linear
label: Linear
description: Issue tracking for modern software teams

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: In Linear open Settings, Security & access, and create a personal API key (it starts with lin_api_). Triggers need a key created by a workspace admin.

body.query: query { teams(first: 250) { nodes { id name } } }
query States($team: ID) { workflowStates(first: 250, filter: {team: {id: {eq: $team}}}) { nodes { id name } } }
query { issuePriorityValues { priority label } }
query { users(first: 250) { nodes { id name } } }
query Templates($team: String!) { team(id: $team) { templates(first: 250) { nodes { id name } } } }
query { projects(first: 250) { nodes { id name } } }
query Cycles($team: ID) { cycles(first: 250, filter: {team: {id: {eq: $team}}, isPast: {eq: false}}) { nodes { id name: number } } }
query Issues($team: ID) { issues(first: 50, orderBy: updatedAt, filter: {team: {id: {eq: $team}}}) { nodes { id title } } }
query Labels($team: ID) { issueLabels(first: 250, filter: {or: [{team: {id: {eq: $team}}}, {team: {null: true}}]}) { nodes { id name } } }
query { projectStatuses(first: 100) { nodes { id name } } }
